Beatrice's fruit roll-up sheet was 2 roll-ups wide and 24 roll-ups long, so she ate \(2 \times 24 = 48\) roll-ups. Marcell's sheet was 3 roll-ups wide and 14 roll-ups long, so he ate \(3 \times 14 = 42\) roll-ups. Together they ate \(48 + 42 = 90\) roll-ups. The average number eaten is \(90 \div 2 = 45\).

Answer: 45
